ev.q: Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare is a 2007 first-person shooter game
is instead set in modern times
includes free-for-all and team-based multiplayer modes on a set of maps
contains a leveling system that allows the player to unlock additional weapons
The custom-class system lets players choose a primary weapon, sidearm, attachments, a special grenade, and three perks
The campaign also contains 30 collectible pieces of enemy intel
The game was critically acclaimed, especially for its gameplay and storyline
while noting that the campaign remained linear
Criticism focused mainly on the short length and linear structure of the single-player campaign
